The '''Irmenu system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the fringes of the [[Crombach Nebula/Legends|Crombach Nebula]] in the [[Belsmuth sector/Legends|Belsmuth sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Irmenu]].<ref name="ZotR" />
